svg.title: Chart: The bell curve
svg.desc: Chart titled “The bell curve”. Horizontal axis, from -4 to 4. Vertical axis, from 0 to 0.47. 4 series. Series 1, area: y = exp(-x^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi), for x from -3 to 3; y is lowest, 0.0044, at x = 3, and highest, 0.399, at x = -0.015. Series 2, area: y = exp(-x^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi), for x from -2 to 2; y is lowest, 0.054, at x = -2, and highest, 0.399, at x = -0.01. Series 3, area: y = exp(-x^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi), for x from -1 to 1; y is lowest, 0.242, at x = -1, and highest, 0.399, at x = -0.015. Series 4, line: y = exp(-x^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi), for x from -4 to 4; y is lowest, 0.0001, at x = -4, and highest, 0.399, at x = -0.02. Other text: 68.3 percent; 13.6 percent; 13.6 percent; 2.1 percent; 2.1 percent; f open paren x close paren equals fraction, 1, over sigma square root of 2 pi, end root, end fraction e to the power, negative fraction, open paren x minus mu close paren squared, over 2 sigma squared, end fraction, end exponent.
